questions.prompt: What is the capital city of Oman?

hints.nudge: A capital city is where a country’s government meets. The other three are capital cities too, of other countries.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Oman article.

questions.proof: The capital is Muscat, Oman has a total area of 322,731 km² which makes it slightly bigger than Ivory Coast.

questions.prompt: Which of these countries shares a border with Oman?

hints.nudge: Two countries are neighbours when you can walk from one into the other. Picture Oman on the globe and look at what it touches.
hints.whereToLook: Look in the opening paragraphs of the Oman article.

questions.proof: It borders the United Arab Emirates to the northwest, Saudi Arabia to the west, and Yemen to the southwest.
